The 2025 Openfront Masters Winter Minor is the last OFM seasonal event of the year, being organized as a qualifier for the 2026 Openfront Winter Major.

About

Format

  • 6 trio matches played using a match-point system
  • Teams earn points based on their maximum land size reached during each match
  • Point Distribution (per match)
    • 1st: 50 points
    • 2nd: 35 points
    • 3rd: 20 points
    • 4th: 10 points
    • 5th: 5 points
    • 6th+: 0 points
  • Top ten teams advance to the 2026 Openfront Winter Major
  • Scoring Method
    • At the end of each match, referees record the largest territory size each team reached at any moment during the game
    • Teams are ranked using this maximum land value, and points are awarded accordingly
